book.name: Rom
book.title: Rom Sesoanamba Nengavnangva Lohvna, Osm Lopshalm Pim.

content: Yeoa indkumbioa wohengivm duangna moamoa. Mongova indhanariniva moamba wulluhvmoa hevhova, owai, Sesoa vraohv keknasowolva, nonamba moamba wulluholmba. Noinda mongova indhanariniva daipotava wulluhvmoa, nomba moamba keknasowolhuiva Sesoanaminiva.
Wo mongova yimba himba nomba ovunvrava gavmanmba, himba wohovov, nom temba Sesoa ten ishunnam. Wo himba wuloprav hukum hevm.

Hindva nomba temba vivpa beswonamba, himba pemba vivmoa duangnapenamba. Wo heva os indhanamba nomba temba tetevulva vrivpa, heoa pem vinvra henapenamoa. Es hevpa yimba ningvmi, pepehhuiva loholmba duangna novrava? Wo nongas vivm, ovra, memba honamba lehra besal, wo duangva si yemba wivewol vevra.

Duangva Sesoana andranindrini, yem kolvrowol velm. Wo heva os yimba tetevulva vrivrava, wo osoa pem vivm. Henamba moamba lohv keknam, manara, himba Sesoana andranindrini, hukum vewolalm henom, ten tetevul avramana vevm.
Wo noinda osva yeoa wohengwol vivm duangmoa. Yeoa wohengivm, noindava osrangasva owai, si homeis kam hukum vivm, heva os noinda osra, yimba nonora av, memba besal, honamba manam manam velmba.
Wo osrata, yimba taeks diva dembhasuv vev. Duangva andra vev Sesoana, wo himba hevna nambaiva pilpiav hevna andrarava.

Taeks dioa dembhasuv vinvm duangmoa indkumbimoa, noinda osra, lohohmorava os lohv. Himba mana vemava indanamba dumbvrava yenamba taeksramba, dembhasuv wohvivm. Osoa hena moamoa mongawa aongna ahalunvm.

Mana vemava yimba owapevnamba vrallava, eva yeoa henga hemoa esesm vrahota. Eva yeoa elsus daswolvm, pevna und vewoloa hemoa. Mongova indhanariniva und vewol vevrava monglamba, himba temba wohengv lohohmom Sesoanam.

content.text: Manam yimba undva vrevav tlatrinimba ungevlirinimba, kevralmba. Yimba manam indhanarinimba mongomba helvakomandhavav. Yimba manam yukovpa vivra. Yimba manam owapevnamba mana vemava muemb vinvra, dombolmba. Kisim Bek 20:13-17

content: Memba honamba moamba eva mongla, tanam mongalnonoa monahulumbkumbi,

content.text: Und vewol vivm monglamoa indhanamoa, os pev ten pevm und vewol vivm. Wok Pris 19:18

content: Und vewol velmba owai, indkokla vewol vevmoa indhanamba. Wo noinda osva nonamba yimba monglamba und vewol vellava, yimba nona Sesoana lohohmomba wohengvra.

Kava ishov honamba, manara, nambaiva doa dihi mura kekslala vrev, Yesusva prolmba, pimba wohlopshalmba. Lehrata, doa mani om yimba ninmba shaulanama, pulvo. Yenamba kinmba doa mura daipotava plel velm vinv. Nonamba pivva seilva Kristusmba keknam undnahonam wohamnana, mendah henamba nambaiva ehallava lohvnamba, prolmba. Heva os daipotava owai.

Simba doa murapeta kuk vilihapihav. Wo nambaiva doa men mura prov, pimba lopshalmba. Wo doa kivralohra pioa nomoa manam manam sahoklalmoa, temba sinamba lohvpa, wo vralohra manimani, nonam kuvhoawol velm sahaposwom.

Pioa doa alohra besalmonam, os no indhana ten avm upsillangas. Pimba manam vivra tihkokla, daipva hlavra. Owaimomolva diva yimba aonglasongla vevramoa, osva snanovna snanovna, daosva owai, lohvavmoa, undva sahonam vrinvra monglamba.
Wo heva os pioa nengavnangoa vrelohra, no mendekli Yesus Kristusna wevsamangas, wo pimba nomangas wohengivra. Maisasa vrivm nomoa, manimani temba sahoklalva phovpa doaramini undriniva.
